_meta: G7.1 D7 / H8 CNOPS71 (docs/G71_SCOPE.md D7, H8): CN strike-team area missions (sim/systems/cnmission71.gd) and the facility turnaround. Every number PROVISIONAL (CNOPS71 picked it; the scope leaves it open). Times in s, distances in tiles, every / wd_every in ticks.

_notes.wd_s: stuck watchdog: a step whose progress signature (phase, team tile, deploy phase, creep cover, sweep index) is unchanged this long re-plans; wd_tries re-plans on one step -> the node is skipped and reported
_notes.sweep_lane: lawnmower lane spacing of the search drone (drone_sight 6 -> lanes overlap by 4 tiles)
_notes.exfil_hp: team health share under which the team exfils instead of chaining to the next node

_notes.heal_hp_s: hp/s healed per rider (in the APC cargo) while the team stands in the airlock wash / inner gate (the aid station gives 6/s to soldiers on foot)
_notes.on: H8 turnaround: heal + rearm in the airlock; a cn_rollout during the return is queued and the team leaves from the inner gate (no garage, no loading stop when all are aboard)

upgrades._notes: H8 facility upgrades (CNOPS71-8/9, roster Q5): per kind a list of tiers; cost paid by the fac_upgrade order, built over build_s seconds (x base training mult; one at a time). bays: airlock turnaround heal / decon multipliers; foundry: build_mult stored (suit-foundry hook open). PROVISIONAL numbers.

siege._notes: H8 facility under siege (CNOPS71-9, roster Q20): staged response alert -> lockdown -> evac (sim/systems/cn_facility.gd siege). PROVISIONAL.

_notes.all: G7.1 B7 VANTA2 (sim/systems/vanta7.gd _flight2 / _fire_mg), every number PROVISIONAL (CNOPS71-11). Speeds in tiles/s (accel / decel tiles/s^2), angles in degrees.
_notes.cruise_mult: x the loaded def speed (A5 already applied at load): Vanta2 cruise
_notes.pivot_frac: under this share of cruise the craft pivots at pivot_deg_s (VTOL agility when slow); faster it turns at most turn_deg_s and banks
_notes.strafe_len: an attack order flies passes through the target, ending this far past it, then turns back
_notes.mg_mount: twin front MGs, metres on the airframe (f forward, r right of the centreline, z up); mirrored left / right

gear_presets._notes: H8 gear availability (CNOPS71-11, PROVISIONAL): the CN kit per armory loadout preset (rules.cards8b.presets ids; the armory card sets one per team role and the team picks it up in its garage). gr = nanite grenades per mission, sd 1/0 = shield drone, pc 1/0 = purge cannon. A team with no preset carries the full kit (mission gr_n, shield, cannon).
